evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratification is a settled past act (realis, past); the contract's named artifacts (remember, receipt) are concrete particulars.

evidence.quote:
No blocking
call, and no lost work

observations.why: Stated as a current property of the system (present, realis); 'blocking call' and 'lost work' are abstract categories, not named events.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: 'Either…or' lays out two possible future paths the agent may take (irrealis, future); polls, run, reaction, later call are concrete system artifacts.
